pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with highly irregular, jagged edges. Geometry is characterized by starburst-like projections and sharp pixel-level transitions between dark patches and light inter-patch spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected web of light-cream pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily 3-way and 4-way intersections with narrow, consistent pixel thickness relative to patch size.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Upper neck mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D profile, appearing as a dense, short bristly silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two oxpecker birds (Buphagus sp.) on the dorsal neck region; one bird is centrally located with a visible red beak, while a second is partially visible at the upper vertical margin of the frame.
